[SWS_CM_10412] Invoking GetHandlers
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00218
⌈
The registered
GetHandler
shall be called by the implementation whenever the
Communication Management receives a
Get()
.
⌋
[SWS_CM_00824] Minimum Send Interval monitoring for GetHandlers calls by
the client
⌈
To protect receivers from flooding/overload, each
Get()
of the respective
field class shall have a configurable Minimum Send Interval (cf. ServiceInterfaceDe-
ploymentElement.minimumSendInterval), which specifies the minimum amount of time
that shall pass between two consecutive calls of GetHandlers by the client, i.e., the
Minimum Send Interval limits the maximum Tx frequency of a given
Get()
call for a
Field in the network. If the application tries to
Field::Get()
a field value, by in-
voking
Get()
of the respective field class,
ara::com
shall check, whether the time
since the last successful handover of the
Get()
call the underlying transmission layer
is greater than the specified Minimum Send Interval, i.e., the Minimum Send Interval
is not violated. If the
Get()
handler has never been invoked before, this shall also
successfully pass the Minimum Send Interval check. If the Minimum Send Interval is
not violated,
ara::com
shall process the
Field::Get()
call by handing it over to the
transmission layer. The time of handover shall count as start of the new Minimum Send
Interval monitoring. If the Minimum Send Interval is violated,
ara::com
shall discard
the
Field::Get()
call, and return the error code
ComErrc::kMinimumSendIn-
tervalViolationError
(see [SWS_CM_10432]) shall be returned via the
